senses.gloss:
Apsas.--This word usually refers to the body, meaning ‘front part.’ In one passage of the Rigveda, however, the adjective ‘with a long front part’ (dīrghāpsas) is applied to the chariot (ratha).
Foot notes See Pischel, Vedische Studien, 1, 308-313; 2, 245, 246.
i. 122, 15. Cf. Roth, St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
